The municipality of Babak contains the barrios of Babak, which
shall be the seat of the municipal government, and Libuak
(Date used in defining boundaries are those of the Census Atlas
of the Philippines, Vol. V, 1939 Census, and Davao District En-
gineer's notes.)
The municipality of Padada shall have its present terri-
tory minus the portions thereof comprised in the munic-
ipalities of Malalag and Hagonoy.
The municipality of Tagum shall have its present terri-
tory minus the portion thereof. comprised in the munic-
ipality of Doña Alicia.
The municipality of Pantukan shall have its present
territory minus the portion thereof comprised in the munic-
ipality of Doña Alicia.
The municipality of Samal shall have its present terri-
tory minus the portion thereof comprised in the munic-
ipality of Babak.
The municinalities of Hagonoy, Malalag, Doña Alicia
and Babak hercin created shall each begin to exist upon
the appointment and qualification of the mayor, vice-mayor
and a majority of the councilors thereof and upon the cer-
tification by the Secretary of Finance of the Provincial
Treasurer of Davao that they are financially capable of
implementing the provisions of the Minimum Wage Law.
Done in the City of Manila, this 28th day of May, in the
year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-three, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the seventh.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
